result.title: Regularized free deconvolution for spectral repair of resampling distortion in high-dimensional particle filters
result.comment: This is a preprint of an article submitted to Signal Processing (Elsevier). The implementation and experiment scripts are available at https://github.com/songming-teaching/spectral-repair-resampling. This is the second paper in a series on spectral analysis of particle filters. The first paper is available at arXiv:2610.16680
result.summary: Resampling is the standard remedy for weight degeneracy in particle filters, but in high dimensions it distorts the spectrum of the ensemble covariance in a way that is computable from the importance weights. This paper studies the inverse problem: recovering the pre-resampling spectrum from the observed weights and the empirical spectrum alone, and using it without biasing the filter. We first show that the forward spectral law extends to random importance weights once one conditions on the weights together with the realized offspring counts, rather than on the weights alone. We then construct a regularized free-deconvolution estimator, prove its consistency with an explicit error budget at a fixed resolution scale, and certify model mismatch through a computable forward residual. The repaired spectrum enters the filter only as the preconditioner of a Metropolis-adjusted rejuvenation move, so that spectral error affects mixing efficiency but not the invariant target. For the full filtering cycle, we derive a geometrically summable error recursion under stable scalar dynamics and an explicit law for the cost of abstaining from repair. Pre-registered simulations show that the inversion reduces the spectral error by an order of magnitude, that the corrected preconditioner recovers about 90% of the oracle's sampling efficiency in an anisotropic regime, and that the cost of abstention depends on when abstentions occur rather than on how many. The repair recovers eigenvalue laws, not eigenvectors, and is certified only within an explicitly stated exogenous-weight regime.

AI.brief_summary: 研究高维粒子滤波中重采样对系综协方差谱的失真，构建正则化自由反卷积估计器，从观测权重与经验谱反推重采样前的谱，并将其仅作为 Metropolis 校正 rejuvenation 的预条件子以避免偏置目标分布。
AI.relevance_reason: 粒子滤波的加权粒子集合与重采样／剪枝可类比 LVR 中多条 latent 假设的维护与筛选，其「无偏地修复被破坏的谱」「弃权代价」分析可能为 latent 表示的失真与信息坍缩提供概念线索，可供核查但非直接证据。
